author: Colin Nicolson
text: In the UK, you can go through the scanners and leave your spare sensors in your hand luggage. The new systems that UK airports use are fine. The only thing you shouldn’t do is pack your insulin in the hold luggage. That must go in your carry on.  Oh and I’ve gone through four parts of the world’s scanners with no adverse affects.

author: Tina Willavoys
text: I’ve been through the scanner plenty of times with no problems and I always leave my spare scanners in my hand luggage bag don’t need to take them out of the bag
